description: This Java class defines an Akka actor `SingletonStatusReporter` that reports health status for a singleton actor within an Akka cluster, only when the node is the cluster leader for a specific role. It implements health checking logic, message handling, and interacts with cluster membership information.

classes.name: SingletonStatusReporter
classes.description: An Akka actor class that reports health status for a singleton actor only if the node is the cluster role leader. It extends `AbstractHealthCheckingActor` and overrides methods for message handling and health retrieval.

methods.name: props
methods.description: A static factory method to create Props for creating instances of `SingletonStatusReporter`, parameterized by cluster role and coordination proxy.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Handles incoming messages of type `RetrieveHealthResponse` to update health status.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Triggers health retrieval if the node is the cluster role leader; otherwise, sets status to 'not my business'.

methods.name: isThisClusterRoleLeader
methods.description: Checks if the current node's address matches the cluster role leader address for the specified role.
